info.title: Autoposting API
info.description: Schedule, publish, and AI-enhance social content across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, and YouTube. All responses use the `{ "success": boolean, "data": ... }` envelope. Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer sk-social-...` or `x-api-key: sk-social-...`).

autoPublish.description: If true, the agent publishes posts immediately. If false, posts are saved as drafts for review.
